description: Fetch one NASA ASRS aviation safety report by its ACN (Accession Number) — the full de-identified narrative plus every coded field (date, airport, state, aircraft, flight phase, coded anomaly types, contributing factors) and the official synopsis. Use after asrs_search returns a report's ACN and you need the complete narrative rather than the excerpt.

acn.description: The report's ACN (Accession Number), e.g. "2093064". Returned by asrs_search.

name: asrs_report
